final_latches.inference: A is wired to track when sap>san (followers driven by sp/sn), while B is selected; B is wired to track when sbn>sbp (followers driven by sn/sp), while A is selected. The selected branch is wired for hold. Follower lag and transient behavior are unmeasured.

documented_behavior.excerpt: * Fully static positive-edge DFF; asynchronous active-low reset clears BOTH latches.

reusable_cmos_dff.polarity: positive-edge clk; asynchronous active-low rst_b clears master and slave; noninverting q
reusable_cmos_dff.interpretation: Master enable is NOR(clk,slave_en); slave enable is NOR(clk_b,master_en). Reset drives each internal x low while disabling pass/hold; two inverters produce q=0.
reusable_cmos_dff.cell_usage: Available CMOS cell only; absent from the audited data-lane path.
reusable_cmos_dff.missing_characterization: No timing characterization for these cells driving this CMOS-to-CML input is provided by this package.
